title: Ordinary common-stage boundary images with induced Frobenius pairs
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the common-stage pair category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] with its standard constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. For a closed immersion $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ of finite-type $k_0$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $i^*$ be the recorded inverse image on the hearts of their geometric fibers [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. Define ordinary $i_*$ as its right adjoint with its adjunction. It is the ordinary sheaf image $(i_*G)(V)=G(V\times_C Z)$; the adjunction determines it up to its unique compatible isomorphism. For ordinary open image on a smooth curve use the existing $j_*$ and its ordinary adjunction [def-wf-middle-extension].

Here is the induced Weil structure, for either ordinary image and more generally any adjunction $a:f^*\dashv R$ on those hearts. Write $\Phi_X,\Phi_Y$ for geometric Frobenius inverse image, and $b:\Phi_X f^*\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*\Phi_Y$ for the canonical inverse-image composition square of [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. For a Weil sheaf $(K,\theta_K)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], the induced arrow $\theta_{RK}:\Phi_Y RK\to RK$ is the adjunct of
$$f^*\Phi_Y RK\xrightarrow{b^{-1}_{RK}}\Phi_X f^*RK\xrightarrow{\Phi_X(\epsilon_K)}\Phi_XK\xrightarrow{\theta_K}K.$$
It is an isomorphism: the inverse geometric Frobenius square gives its inverse by adjunction and the triangle identities. The induced fixed pair has exactly the carrier $RK$ and this isomorphism, in the recorded common-stage fixed-pair category. Finally, given the cohomological shift-commutation structure $s$ of $\Phi_Y$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the shifted pair has carrier $K[1]$ and structure $\Phi_Y(K[1])\xrightarrow{s}\Phi_Y(K)[1]\xrightarrow{\theta_K[1]}K[1]$. No triangulation on fixed pairs is asserted.
